summary: A status report listing the currently assigned values from several series of numbers used in network protocol implementations. It collected in one place the numbers that protocols agreed to share and replaced earlier editions. It is now historic, and was itself replaced by RFC 1010.

eli5.summary: Many machines need to agree that certain numbers mean certain things, like a phone book. This memo was one edition of that phone book.

questions: where were protocol numbers listed in 1986
